name: 77357 · New Caney, TX
findings: ZIP 77357 (New Caney) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77357 (New Caney) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77357 (New Caney) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
